questions.question: Commit + push these changes now, or hold for your review?

options.label: Commit both repos now — dstrader-secrets push, worktree local commit (Recommended)
options.description: Push the two moved runbooks to dstrader-secrets (safe — private repo, no live deploy impact). Commit the worktree's de-personalization changes on the bridge branch (NOT pushed to dstrader-docker; stays on the branch for /close-work to handle). You can paper-trade verify before that merges.

options.label: Push secrets repo, leave worktree uncommitted
options.description: Same as above but skip the worktree commit so you see the full diff before agreeing. Riskier — if the session ends the changes sit dirty.

options.label: Don’t commit anything; let me review the diff first
options.description: Hold both. I’ll wait. You can `git diff` in the worktree and `cd ~/dev/dstrader-secrets && git status` to inspect.
